specs.title: Deposits and no-show fees
specs.why: Deposits are the merchant's main defence against no-shows and a core selling point.
specs.scope: Per-service deposit as a percentage or flat kobo amount. Remaining balance captured at check-in or via a follow-up link. No-show fee chargeable from stored authorization.
tasks: Split payment into deposit and balance records
acceptance: A deposit-only booking holds the slot as `confirmed_partial`
Balance capture succeeds and closes the booking
The no-show fee is recorded in the ledger

specs.title: Payout ledger
specs.why: Money movement must be auditable and reconcilable, which requires an append-only record.
specs.scope: Immutable `LedgerEntry` table (gross, provider fee, platform fee, net, direction). Tenant-facing payout dashboard at `/app/payouts`.
tasks: Write entries on payment success, refund and payout
Daily reconciliation job against the provider statement
acceptance: Ledger totals match the provider daily statement to the kobo
`UPDATE` and `DELETE` on `LedgerEntry` are rejected by constraint
CSV export downloads for any date range
